text:
Jordan: Heads-up: planning a coordinated deploy for API + runtime + console + router in the 02:00 UTC change window tonight. Need pin decisions + rollback criteria. @Maya @Sam @Lina
Sam: I can take runtime and router. Which runtime variant are we shipping?
Maya: API will move to v3.2.0 (no schema changes). Console needs the new routes in API; will be behind a feature flag. Runtime is shipping the kernel-batching switch and KV cache migration.
Lina: For router I'd like to pin but keep a fallback — accept both v3 and v3.2 during canary. Proposal: `router:route:pin=v3.2.0,fallback=v3`
Jordan: deploy-bot scheduled start at 02:10 UTC. plan: canary 1% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% with 15m holds between waves.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: id=4512345678, canary schedule 1/10/50/100, hold=15m. Auto-rollback triggers: 5xx spike >3% during a hold or p50 latency +300ms vs baseline.
Sam: Runtime note: KV cache migration included in this build. Watch `kv-evict` and `oom` patterns. If we see sustained evictions or OOMs, immediate rollback.
Maya: API release notes updated: `breaking=false`. New header `x-rdwd-feature` is optional. Primary monitors: `/generate`, `/chat` error rates and P95 latency.
Lina: Console will be rolled out behind flag `console_new_routes_v3_2`. If console errors >1% for 5m flip the flag off. Where do we signal abort—this thread or #incidents?
Jordan: Signal here first; if deploy-bot issues `canary-fail` we escalate to #incidents. Manual rollback command (ops runbook):
```
deployctl rollback --id 4512345678 --scope all
```
Sam: Agreed. Post-rollback actions: create incident ticket, assign runtime + router owners for triage and follow-up.
Maya: I'll be on standby 01:45-03:30 UTC. Lina — can you confirm the exact flag name and add the router pin step to the release docs?
Lina: Confirmed flag name `console_new_routes_v3_2`. I'll update the runbook with router pin + fallback snippet.
Jordan: Quick checklist in-thread: 1) pin router with fallback 2) deploy-bot canary waves 3) monitor p50/p95 and 5xx by route 4) manual rollback command in runbook 5) postmortem owner assigned if rollback. Anything else? @deploy-bot
deploy-bot: Ack — I'll post wave updates here and signal `canary-fail` if any auto-triggers fire. Good luck everyone :thumbsup:
